Hawaii Family Trip

The group starts in two places — eight head to the Big Island a few days early, seven fly straight to Kauai — and all 15 come together in Poipu on Dec 26 for the week through New Year.

Tue Dec 22, 2026 – Sat Jan 2, 2027 12 days · 11 nights Kona, Big Island · 4 nights Poipu, Kauai · 7 nights
Overview

The shape of the trip

This page is the family hub for the trip — flights, itinerary, lodging, transport, dining, and what's still open — and it updates as each piece gets confirmed, just like the Japan trip page.

Dec 22 → Jan 2A split start and a split finish — everyone meets on Kauai Dec 26 and leaves Lihue Jan 2, bound for three different places
2 islandsBig Island (Kona) Dec 22–26 for 8 of the group, then all 15 on Kauai (Poipu) Dec 26–Jan 2
15 guests6 adults + 9 kids, all together at Koloa Landing in three villas — every assignment now confirmed

Two ways in — the group starts separated

Path 1 — the Big Island first (8 people):

Chicago O'Hare (ORD) → Kona (KOA) → Southwest to Lihue, Kauai (LIH)

The Sullivan family — Todd Sullivan, Jeannie Sullivan, Natalie, Rory, Dashiell (Dash), and Phoebe — plus Bob and Arly go down a few days early — Tue Dec 22 — for the Big Island, staying at Big Island Koi Hale in Kailua-Kona (booked — see Lodging). On Sat Dec 26 they fly Southwest from Kona to Lihue — WN #3234 to Honolulu, then WN #2024 — landing at 6:05 PM (confirmation #C2JB2H, booked).

Path 2 — straight to Kauai (7 people):

Home → Lihue, Kauai (LIH)

Kate's family — Kate, Maurice, Madeline, Max, Sam, Mason, and Charlotte — skip the Big Island and fly from Detroit into Lihue on Delta via Seattle (DL734 / DL345, confirmation JLX86T), landing Sat Dec 26 at 8:22 PM — that's the meet-up: all 15 together at Koloa Landing that night.

One day out, three ways home — Sat Jan 2:

  • Todd, Jeannie, Natalie, Rory, Dash, and Phoebe — back to Chicago (ORD), on American AA673, the 10:20 PM departure from Lihue
  • Kate, Maurice, Madeline, Max, Sam, Mason, and Charlotte — home via a long Honolulu layover, with Pearl Harbor booked for that day
  • Bob and Arly — stop off in California to visit friends

Still outstanding — Bob and Arly's California return only

  • Bob and Arly's return from Lihue to California — the only flight info still outstanding; Todd is asking them for it. Their inbound and the Southwest hop are booked, and their return is separate from the Sullivan family's (California stop after Kauai)
  • Ground transport — any additional Lihue cars? The one booked Telluride seats 7–8 of 15

Confirmed: the Sullivan family's American round trip is booked and ticketed, and Bob and Arly's inbound from Detroit is booked — AA1569 + AA229, confirmation YGDJVO, arriving Kona with everyone on AA229 at 3:17 PM (see Flights). Also confirmed: Kate's family's flights are booked — Delta out (JLX86T) and Alaska back (SWPHOP) via the Pearl Harbor layover day, Orbitz itinerary #73511820610686 — plus all three Koloa Landing villa assignments (see Lodging), and the “glass-bottom boat” in Kate's plan is the same Na Pali charter already booked — it appears once on this page, as booked.

Itinerary

Day by day

The trip starts split — eight on the Big Island from Dec 22, seven arriving straight to Kauai — and everyone is together from the Dec 26 meet-up on. The Kauai week has a shape, from Kate's plan: the villas have kitchens, so breakfasts and most lunches are in and dinners are out. Three things are booked and fixed — the Dec 28 Na Pali charter, the Dec 29 luau, and Pearl Harbor on Jan 2 (Kate, Maurice, and the kids, on their way home) — and the rest flexes around them.

  • Tue Dec 22 · Big IslandArrive in Kona — 8 of the groupThe Sullivan family flies American ORD → DFW (AA3180) → Kona on AA229, and Bob and Arly fly Detroit → DFW (AA1569) and join the same AA229 — all 8 arrive in Kona (KOA) together at 3:17 PM a few days early and pick up the booked Ford Transit at the airport (3:00 PM). Check in at Big Island Koi Hale, 78-6641 Ali'i Drive, Kailua-Kona — check-in Tue Dec 22, 3:00 PM, hosted by Barb, confirmation #HMT4BJMSHM. Check-in is by lockbox — reach out to the host for how to check in. First of 4 nights on the Big Island. Kate's family isn't on this leg — they fly straight to Kauai on Dec 26.
  • Wed Dec 23 · Big IslandBig Island dayFor the eight, based at Big Island Koi Hale in Kailua-Kona, with the Ford Transit for getting around. Day unplanned so far.
  • Thu Dec 24 · Big Island · Christmas EveChristmas Eve — candlelight service at Mokuaikaua ChurchEvening: Christmas Eve candlelight service at Mokuaikaua Church, 75-5713 Ali'i Drive, Kailua-Kona — Hawaii's first Christian church, founded 1820 — for the 8 on the Big Island (the Sullivan family plus Bob and Arly). The service is traditionally in the evening, around 8pm with caroling beforehand, but the 2026 time is not confirmed yet — confirm the exact time closer to the date.
  • Fri Dec 25 · Big Island · Christmas DayChristmas DayChristmas Day falls on the Big Island leg, so a Christmas plan (and any restaurant booking, which will go fast over the holidays) is worth deciding early.
  • Sat Dec 26 · Travel dayKona → Lihue, Kauai — meet-up day & arrival nightCheck out of Big Island Koi Hale by 11:00 AM, return the Transit at Kona (3:00 PM), and fly Southwest (booked, confirmation #C2JB2H): WN #3234 KOA 3:40 PM → HNL 4:30 PM, change planes, then WN #2024 HNL 5:20 PM → LIH 6:05 PM — all eight (Todd, Jeannie, Natalie, Rory, Dash, Phoebe, Bob, and Arly). Kate, Maurice, Madeline, Max, Sam, Mason, and Charlotte land at 8:22 PM, flying straight into Kauai — all 15 together from here. Pick up the Telluride at Lihue Airport and check in at Koloa Landing Resort, Poipu (4:00 PM check-in) for 7 nights. No dinner reservation — Kate's family lands too late for Holo Holo, so the fallback is the resort's 24-hour Gourmet Marketplace or pre-arrival villa stocking (groceries + 22% service charge, 48 hrs notice); the 6:05 PM arrivals can eat normally. No Costco run today — it closes 7:00 PM on Saturdays.
  • Sun Dec 27 · KauaiWaimea Canyon day — all 15Kalaheo Cafe breakfast on the way to Waimea Canyon. Drive-up lookouts for everyone, including Arly; the Canyon Trail hike is opt-in, and Koke'e hikes bolt onto the same drive.
  • Mon Dec 28 · KauaiNa Pali Coast Private Charter — bookedNa Pali Experience, 7:30 AM – 12:00 PM from Kikiaola Small Boat Harbor, Kekaha. Check-in 7:00 AM, all 15 going, waivers needed for everyone including minors. This is the boat Kate's plan calls the “glass-bottom boat” — the same booking, confirmed. Full details in Things to Do. The Costco run slots in naturally after the boat. Dinner option: Keoki's Paradise (see Dining).
  • Tue Dec 29 · KauaiLuau — booked / fixedThe group's luau night, on Kate's plan as already booked — it doubles as the week's big group night alongside the dinner options.
  • Wed Dec 30 · KauaiAdults' night — plus a tubing call still openDaytime option: tubing for a subset at 12:40 PM — undecided, ~$165–175/person for ~45–60 minutes in the tube (see Things to Do); Arly's alternative that day is Kilohana Plantation. Evening: adults' night — the kids get pizza at the resort and the 6 adults go out; leading dinner pick is Red Salt, roughly $600–$900 all-in for 6 (option only, nothing booked). A Hanalei / north shore day could also land here if it dawns driest.
  • Thu Dec 31 · KauaiNew Year's Eve — direction decided, nothing bookedAll 15 together, togetherness over fancy; the adults-only NYE idea is off. Shape: an early, casual all-15 dinner — Holo Holo at the resort is the easiest option, Eating House 1849 the alternative — then drinks and snacks back in the villas. See Dining.
  • Fri Jan 1 · KauaiBuffer day — deliberately emptyLeft open on purpose as a buffer / weather-swap day — the natural slot for the Hanalei / north shore day if Dec 30 was wet. Dinner still open: Brennecke's Beach Broiler or Holo Holo (options).
  • Sat Jan 2 · Travel dayEveryone leaves — three different destinationsCheck out of Koloa Landing by 11:00 AM, Telluride back to Lihue Airport by 3:00 PM, then the group splits three ways: Todd, Jeannie, Natalie, Rory, Dash, and Phoebe fly back to Chicago (ORD) on American AA673, the 10:20 PM departure; Kate, Maurice, Madeline, Max, Sam, Mason, and Charlotte stop off at Pearl Harbor on the way home (long Honolulu layover, Pearl Harbor booked); Bob and Arly stop off in California to visit friends.

Dining

Kauai dinner options — nothing booked yet

Every dinner below is an option only until someone books it. Kate's rules for the week: book ahead, mostly casual with 1–2 nice nights at most, no set menus (except possibly NYE), no allergies in the group, one check is fine — and nothing goes on a card hold until the cancellation terms have been seen.

The gluten-free rule

Jeanne is gluten free for Hashimoto's — permanently, for every restaurant on this trip. Cross-contamination is OK, but dishes themselves must be gluten free (tamari in place of soy sauce, no wheat-based sauces or breading). Every option below gets checked against that before anything is booked.

Arrival night & Christmas Day

  • Sat Dec 26 arrival (Kauai) — no dinner reservation; too late for Holo Holo after Kate's 8:22 PM landing. Fallback: the resort's 24-hour Gourmet Marketplace, or pre-arrival villa stocking (groceries + 22% service charge, 48 hrs notice)
  • Christmas Day (Fri Dec 25, Big Island) — still unplanned; holiday services book out early and many places run limited menus

Things to Do

Things to Do

Grouped by the two parts of the trip — the Big Island first, then the Kauai week. Three things are booked and fixed: the Na Pali charter (Mon Dec 28), the luau (Tue Dec 29), and Pearl Harbor (Sat Jan 2 — Kate, Maurice, and the kids stop there on their way home). Below the charter: the still-open activities from Kate's plan, then the signature sights on each island as idea starters.

Big Island — Dec 22–26

Manta ray excursion (Big Island) Planned

Manta ray excursion (Big Island) — planned, details coming from Jeannie.

Hawaii Volcanoes National Park

Big Island · Kilauea's crater, lava tubes, and steam vents — the Big Island's signature day trip from the Kona side. A long drive, so it's a full-day call for the group.

Kona coast beach days

Big Island · Snorkeling, coffee country, and sunset beaches along the Kona coast — the easy, close-to-base days for Dec 23–25.

Kauai — Dec 26–Jan 2

Na Pali Coast Private Charter Booked

Na Pali Experience · Mon Dec 28, 2026 · 7:30 AM – 12:00 PM
Check-in 7:00 AM · Kikiaola Small Boat Harbor, Kekaha, Kauai, HI 96752 · Booking #367422570 · Party of 15

  • Changes: cancellations/reschedules permitted up to 48 hours prior
  • Waivers: digital waivers required for all passengers, including minors — do these before the day
  • Minimum age: 4 (youngest in the group is 10, so everyone clears it)

  • Prep: no coffee before the trip; pack light
  • Snorkeling: gear provided and snorkeling if conditions allow — winter surf decides on the day
  • Getting there: Kekaha is on the far west side, roughly an hour's drive from Poipu — an early start from Koloa Landing

Hikes — a grab-bag, not a schedule

  • Mahaulepu Trail
  • A Koke'e hike or three — some bolt onto the Sun Dec 27 Waimea Canyon drive
  • Iliau Loop
  • Canyon Trail — opt-in on the Dec 27 canyon day

Sam's Poipu morning runs are sorted — three routes from the resort, ~3, ~5, and ~7 miles.

Na Pali Coast

Kauai · The island's famous cliffs — the group sees them by boat on the booked Dec 28 private charter (above). The Kalalau Trail trailhead at Ke'e Beach is the land-based alternative if anyone wants a second look.

Waimea Canyon & Koke'e

Kauai · The “Grand Canyon of the Pacific” — lookouts, short hikes, and Kalalau views from the top. Pairs naturally with a west-side day from Lihue.

Also on most Kauai lists: Poipu Beach (south shore, calmer in winter) and the Wailua River and Fern Grotto. Hanalei Bay and the north shore are covered above as an open day. Shout with the group's picks and this section becomes the real plan, day by day.

Ask a question, or send an update

Anyone on the trip can use this form — a question about the plan, or an update to share (a flight detail, a change of plans, a new idea). Sending opens your own mail app with everything filled in, addressed to Sully, who keeps this page current.
